blind.description: A neat stack of four thick hardbound tomes or books bound together with a buckled leather strap. The books have colored leather covers (black on top, followed by dark red, dark green, and tan/brown on the bottom) with aged cream-colored paper edges. The model has clean, solid, continuous geometry with realistic leather and paper texturing, sitting directly flat on the ground without an added plinth.
blind.from_above: A small dark rectangle showing the top leather book cover crossed centrally by a strapped belt and metallic buckle.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1 foot tall (about one-fifth the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1 foot wide.
